kira_partnerships: Quick pulse check for the marketplace announce: vendors reporting mixed readiness. Need a compact contingency plan for MI300 and Gaudi.
anna_amd: MI300 pilot boards delayed ~2 weeks, partner expects late-June. Will confirm EOD.
marta_gaudi: We found a NIC scheduling issue on Gaudi runtime; patch coming in 5 days if CI passes.
yusuf_cloud: Ops constraint: SKU metadata must land 72h prior to publish. If MI300/Gaudi slip, we should publish core SKUs and add others in a follow-up patch.
peter_sre: Tech note: add a runtime feature-flag for Gaudi KV-caching so we can flip it per-region for canary. I can have that ready in 48h.
sam_legal: Messaging: use "partner preview" and avoid hard dates. For joint PRs require partner asset sign-off 48h before release.
release-bot: Event created: "Marketplace core announce (H100/H200/B200)"  2026-06-22  https://calendar.redwood.ai/e/mkt-core-2026-06-22
kira_partnerships: Decision: ship core SKUs 2026-06-22; mark MI300/Gaudi as "partner preview" and add them if vendors confirm by 6/18. Owners: ops=yusuf_cloud, eng=peter_sre, vendors=anna_amd/marta_gaudi, legal=sam_legal. Ping here with any ETA updates.
